summary: The hash tripwire behind [fresh]/[evidence changed]. Verified 2026-07-24: freshness has NO git dependency whatsoever — grepping this file for 'head' returns zero matches. hashFile is a whole-file raw-byte SHA-256 (first 12 hex, never per-symbol) and stampAnchors compares each anchor's stored hash against the live file NOW, so an anchor's recorded `head` commit is never consulted here. Consequence worth knowing before assuming otherwise: note freshness is content-addressed, not commit-addressed, and therefore survives branch switches and would survive notes living outside git entirely. A missing file resolves through the keeper's rename map only when the destination's live content still equals the recorded hash, so a stale rename hint can never resurrect a note wrongly.
